js: const W=window.__game; W.savanna.effect({type:'migrate', herds:3}); W.debug.ff(40); 'CHECK sav-herd ' + (W.savanna.herds.list.length>=1 ? 'ok '+W.savanna.herds.count() : 'FAIL')

const W=window.__game; for (let i=0;i<120 && !(W.season==='dry' && W.seasonFrac>0.45);i++){ const r=W.debug.ff(30); if (/^modal/.test(r)) W.debug.auto(); } 'CHECK sav-dry ' + (W.season==='dry' && W.seasonFrac>0.45 ? 'ok' : 'FAIL '+W.season+' day '+W.day)

const W=window.__game; const g=W.savanna.grass.stats(); 'CHECK sav-straw ' + (g.g < 0.4 && g.h > 0.5 ? 'ok' : 'FAIL') + ' h ' + g.h.toFixed(2) + ' g ' + g.g.toFixed(2) + ' stab ' + W.stability.toFixed(2) + ' herds ' + W.savanna.herds.list.map(h=>h.kind+':'+h.n+':'+h.state).join(',')
const W=window.__game; const f=W.savanna.startFire(1); W.debug.ff(20); 'CHECK sav-fire ' + (f ? 'ok ' + W.fires.length : 'FAIL no fuel')
const W=window.__game; W.debug.ff(60); const g=W.savanna.grass.stats(); 'CHECK sav-burnt ' + (g.b > 0.01 ? 'ok '+g.b.toFixed(3) : 'FAIL')
